import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Load datasets
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mutations = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')

# 2. Prepare clinical data: filter non-missing Breslow thickness
clin = clinical[['submitter_id', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender', 'breslow_thickness']].rename(
    columns={'submitter_id': 'patient_id'}).dropna(subset=['breslow_thickness'])

# 3. Compute TMB per patient (mutation count)
tmb = mutations.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='tmb')

# 4. Merge Breslow thickness with TMB
df = pd.merge(clin, tmb, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# 5. Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(df['breslow_thickness'], df['tmb'])
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.3e}")

# 6. Linear regression: TMB ~ Breslow + age + gender
model = smf.ols('tmb ~ breslow_thickness + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', data=df).fit()
print('\nRegression results:')
print(f"R-squared: {model.rsquared:.3f}\n")
print('Coefficients:')
print(model.params)
print('\nP-values:')
print(model.pvalues)

# 7. Scatter plot with regression line (unadjusted on Breslow)
x = df['breslow_thickness']
y = df['tmb']
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6)
# line

plt.plot(x_vals, intercept + slope * x_vals, color='red', lw=2)
plt.xlabel('Breslow Thickness (mm)')
plt.ylabel('Tumor Mutational Burden (count)')
plt.title('TMB vs. Breslow Thickness with Linear Fit')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Table of merged Breslow and TMB
table = df[['patient_id', 'breslow_thickness', 'tmb']].sort_values('patient_id')
print(f"\nMerged table: {table.shape[0]} patients")
print(table.to_string(index=False))

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Load datasets
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mutations = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')

# 2. Prepare clinical data: filter non-missing Breslow thickness
clin = clinical[['submitter_id', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender', 'breslow_thickness']].rename(
    columns={'submitter_id': 'patient_id'}).dropna(subset=['breslow_thickness'])

# 3. Compute TMB per patient (mutation count)
tmb = mutations.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='tmb')

# 4. Merge Breslow thickness with TMB
df = pd.merge(clin, tmb, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# 5. Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(df['breslow_thickness'], df['tmb'])
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.3e}")

# 6. Linear regression: TMB ~ Breslow + age + gender
model = smf.ols('tmb ~ breslow_thickness + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', data=df).fit()
print('\nRegression results:')
print(f"R-squared: {model.rsquared:.3f}\n")
print('Coefficients:')
print(model.params)
print('\nP-values:')
print(model.pvalues)

# 7. Scatter plot with regression line (unadjusted on Breslow)
x = df['breslow_thickness']
y = df['tmb']
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6)
# line
x_vals = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 100)
plt.plot(x_vals, intercept + slope * x_vals, color='red', lw=2)
plt.xlabel('Breslow Thickness (mm)')
plt.ylabel('Tumor Mutational Burden (count)')
plt.title('TMB vs. Breslow Thickness with Linear Fit')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Table of merged Breslow and TMB
table = df[['patient_id', 'breslow_thickness', 'tmb']].sort_values('patient_id')
print(f"\nMerged table: {table.shape[0]} patients")
print(table.to_string(index=False))
"}

  – R² = 0.066
  – Breslow_thickness coefficient = –13.60 (p = 0.0839)

  – Male vs. Female coefficient = 454.47 (p = 0.00091)
• Scatter plot with regression line confirms a slight negative relationship.
